title: Dragonfly 7 Red Team review of one draft
description: Written by the Red Team to inbox/YYYY-MM-DD/<trade_id>.redteam.json against the draft, before the engine sizes it. The seven warning flags plus the case against the trade. warning_count is DERIVED by the engine from the flags; a file's own warning_count is optional and ignored if it disagrees. Red Team never sets hard blocks or sizing: keys such as hard_blocks, decision, sizing, units or risk_decision are stripped, logged, and have no effect. The engine sizes a draft only after a valid file is seen, and only if that happens by the 08:20 CT pass.

draft_sha256.description: Optional. sha256 of the draft file reviewed. If present and the draft has changed, the review is stale and ignored.

flag_evidence.description: Optional evidence per raised flag (valuation_extreme needs a cited number; gap_history: gap in the last 60 sessions > 1.5x the planned stop distance).

narrative.description: The written case against the trade, including qualitative concerns the engine cannot measure.

warning_count.description: Optional; ignored. The engine derives it from flags.
